archetypes.name: dyn-occurrence-baseline
archetypes.rationale: Legacy normalized_condition codec and occurrence numbering are easy to drift under engine projection.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the unreachable-branch engine port for occurrence identity fidelity. Confirm Finding.pattern_name carries the normalized condition, occurrence numbers skip pragma-suppressed matches, and baseline JSON round-trips with normalized_condition field order rather than pattern_name. Check that production discovery stays on tracked python/larch paths with the exempt-path filter. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
